name: Brian Moore
title: Personal Injury Attorney
address: 1055 Howell Mill Rd Fl 8, Atlanta, GA 30318
bio: Brian Moore, founder of 404 Lawyer, is a seasoned Personal Injury attorney who specializes in Motor Vehicle Accidents, Slip & Fall cases, Trucking Accidents, Rideshare Accidents, and Pedestrian Motor Vehicle Crashes. He believes big insurance companies pay significant amounts when you have the right lawyer by your side — and is dedicated to restoring the health and wealth of those who have been wronged.

name: Benjamin J. Rollins
title: Managing Attorney
address: 1201 West Peachtree Street, Suite 2300, Atlanta, GA 30309
bio: Benjamin J. Rollins is the Managing Attorney for Rollins Law Group, known for securing significant settlements for victims. He earned his law degree from Atlanta's John Marshall Law School, where he served as President of the Black Law Students Association, and his B.A. in Business from the University of Central Florida. He is admitted to practice in the Northern and Middle District Courts of Georgia.

name: Kurtis Badger, Esq.
title: Owner & Founding Attorney
bio: A graduate of the University of Virginia School of Law (top-ten nationally), Kurtis Badger began his career managing complex multimillion-dollar litigation at one of the world's largest law firms. Driven to serve those wronged, he transitioned to personal injury and founded Badger Law Group — a firm renowned for its empathetic, skilled team dedicated to securing justice and substantial recoveries for clients.

name: Desmond A. Humphrey
title: Personal Injury Attorney & Owner
address: 3355 Lenox Rd NE, Suite 750, Atlanta, GA 30326
bio: An award-winning attorney regularly featured as a legal analyst on Court TV, Desmond A. Humphrey has handled hundreds of personal injury cases with a modern and innovative approach. A licensed minister and community leader, he brings a unique blend of legal prowess and compassionate faith-driven representation to every client.

name: E. David Ballard III
title: Personal Injury Attorney & Owner
address: 3355 Lenox Rd NE, Suite 750, Atlanta, GA 30326
bio: E. David Ballard III began his legal career as a prosecutor in the City of Atlanta Municipal Court, litigating hundreds of cases. His deep knowledge of Georgia traffic codes and formidable courtroom skills have allowed him to recover millions in settlements for personal injury clients, establishing him as a leading Personal Injury expert in the region.

name: John Winkenwerder
title: Attorney at Law
bio: John "Wink" Winkenwerder, Esq., founder of Wink Law, is a Georgia Rising Star recognized by Super Lawyers and Atlanta Magazine for four consecutive years. He combines his competitive drive with insider knowledge of how insurance companies operate — having worked inside defense firms — to maximize recovery for injured clients throughout the Atlanta metro area and across Georgia.

name: Ivan Bracho Gonzalez
title: Attorney at Law
bio: Ivan Bracho Gonzalez brings 13+ years of experience in the legal and judicial systems of the U.S. and Latin America, with a specialization in international arbitration, dispute resolution, and litigation. A native of Venezuela and former appellate judge, he is fully bilingual (English/Spanish) and uniquely qualified to serve clients navigating cross-border legal matters and those more comfortable in Spanish.
